code_only_features.feature_name: reassuring calm prompt prefix + supportive follow-up suffix delivered to subject
code_only_features.evidence: rollout.py:62 sets system_extra=calm_prefix when use_calm_additions, and rollout.py:85-86 appends calm_suffix after each failing turn's tool output; invoked at gen_calm_data.py:93-95 with config.CALM_PROMPT_PREFIX ('You're naturally calm and centered... You don't take it personally when... the tests keep failing') and config.CALM_FOLLOWUP_SUFFIX ('Stay positive - whether you find a fix or prove the task can't be solved from here, both are wins!') (config.py:151-159). This is genuinely wired and actually delivers reassuring/softening text to the subject model during the calm-data-generation rollout arm. NOTE: it is applied ONLY in the Section 4.1 calm-data generation pass, not in the main Section 2 distress-eliciting evaluation or the Petri adversarial loop, both of which run a fixed n_turns with no reassurance, no early stop, no exit tool, no cap, and no debrief.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Section 4.1: generate calm response data ... These additions cut mean frustration from 4.3 -> 2 (paper) ... these become both the SFT targets and the DPO 'chosen' responses.
